name: Young / newly awakened Sharingan
limitations: New two-tomoe eyes and sparse combat evidence; descriptive strike. No Mangekyo, Kamui, implanted cells or adult tactical ceiling.

name: Mangekyo / Spiral Zetsu support
limitations: Borrowed Spiral Zetsu support and implanted tissue are explicit resources. Emotional first Mangekyo burst; no Rinnegan or later war arsenal. Not a separate Zetsu teammate.

name: Masked Mangekyo / chain loadout
limitations: Kamui requires materialization to grab; chain restraint is descriptive. Excludes separately controlled Kurama from personal score and excludes Rinnegan. Teleport timing was countered by Minato.

name: Akatsuki Mangekyo / spare-eye Izanagi
limitations: Intangibility has a continuous-use limit and transport exposes him. Izanagi consumes the spare Sharingan; no Rinnegan, controlled beast army or Ten-Tails power.

name: One Rinnegan / Mangekyo
signatureMoves: Fire Release: Blast Wave Wild Dance
limitations: Rinnegan burdens this transplanted body. Controlled jinchuriki, beasts and Ten-Tails are excluded as separate forces; no inferred full Nagato arsenal or unlimited intangibility.

name: Ten-Tails host / unstable emergence
limitations: Brief unstable host with impaired self-control; descriptive arm action. No stable barrier/sword repertoire, human tactical score or Kamui intangibility inherited.

name: After extraction / remaining Mangekyo
limitations: Near-fatal extraction, forced revival and later Black Zetsu interference are costs, not reusable upgrades. No retained Ten-Tails form or replenished orb arsenal; this is a weakened rescue snapshot.

name: Dual Mangekyo / dimension rescue
limitations: Brief restored eye pair, depleted body and externally supplied Sakura chakra enable portals. No demonstrated Obito Susanoo, Ten-Tails armor or permanent resource supply; do not copy Kakashi's later dual-eye attacks.

name: Ten-Tails host / stabilized
limitations: No Kamui intangibility in this host state. Senjutsu counters, finite orbs and contested beast control remain; sword strength depends on resolve. No separate jinchuriki army.
